CustomField.label: Category
CustomField.description: Optionally groups this Check with related Checks in the card's results summary, such as Completeness, Readiness, Risk, or Compliance. When categories are used, category groups appear alphabetically and Checks without a category appear under Other. Category does not change how the Check is evaluated, ordered, or displayed in the results.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optionally group this Check in the card's results summary. Checks without a category appear under Other. Category does not affect the result.
